messages:
Laura Chen: Quick check — we need to triage the marketplace listing artifacts for ACME HW partner before EOD Friday. Core asks: SOC2 report, latest pen test summary (redacted), supplier questionnaire, and signed NDA. Can owners please confirm where each artifact lives?
Samir Patel: I can pull the SOC2 and pen-test zip from the vault. will need guidance on redaction scope.
Rachel Gomez: For pen-tests: redact IP addresses, internal hostnames, and exploit PoCs. Keep attack surface summary and mitigations.
Tom Nguyen: ACME will want their device model numbers removed from public bundle. They asked for a separate partner-only bundle.
Laura Chen: Good call. Proposed plan: 1) Samir exports raw artifacts to a staging bucket with TTL 48h. 2) Rachel runs redaction pass and produces a partner-only bundle + public bundle. 3) Tom coordinates delivery to ACME and marketplace upload.
Samir Patel: ok. I will upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/acme-2124689012/ and generate presigned links. sharing TTL = 48h.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Heads up — presigned links to external parties require DLP review. Please add access_log=on and tag with "marketplace-evidence". See: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/presign-guidelines
Rachel Gomez: Noted. Redaction checklist (short):
```
- remove private IPs and hostnames
- scrub stack traces containing filepaths
- replace email addresses with <redacted@company>
- strip raw exploit code blocks
- include redaction manifest.csv
```
I'll run this by Legal for final wording.
Tom Nguyen: ACME also needs a letter of attestation that we didn't modify telemetry for their firmware. Legal asked to see proposed wording.
Laura Chen: I'll draft attestation. Rachel, can you include a one-liner in the manifest that confirms redaction did not affect telemetry fields?
Rachel Gomez: Yep. Will add: "Redaction preserved telemetry schema; no telemetry values changed."
Samir Patel: Uploaded raw zip and posted presign links to #private-ops. Link TTL 48h, I set object tags per Maya's note.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Auto-check: DLP tag present, access logging enabled. Reminder: retention for marketplace artifacts is 90 days unless legal override.
Tom Nguyen: I'll schedule the ACME handoff call tomorrow 10am PT and invite Legal + Security.
Laura Chen: Action owners: Samir = upload + presigns; Rachel = redact + manifest; Tom = partner handoff + marketplace upload; Laura = attestation draft + final signoff.
Samir Patel: starting work now, will update thread when presigns are in #private-ops. :thumbsup:
Rachel Gomez: will start redaction after Samir posts links. ETA Thursday noon.
Tom Nguyen: invite sent for 10am PT tomorrow. ACME PM confirmed.
Laura Chen: thanks team — please flag any blockers here.
